description: 适用于队列、病例对照和横断面研究；检查主要章节并要求核对相应清单。
descriptionEn: For cohort, case-control, and cross-sectional studies; checks major sections and requires the applicable checklist.

rules.message: 请在标题或摘要中明确研究设计，并选择对应的队列、病例对照或横断面清单。
rules.messageEn: Identify the study design in the title or abstract and select the matching cohort, case-control, or cross-sectional checklist.

rules.message: 请逐项核对 STROBE 官方清单；该清单用于报告完整性，不是研究质量评分。
rules.messageEn: Check the official STROBE checklist item by item; it supports reporting completeness and is not a study-quality score.
